name: design-guardrail
description: Blocks Write and Edit on UI files that hardcode hex/rgb/hsl colors or px spacing and font values, and names the design token to use instead.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the design token guard on or off.

configFile.title: Project config file
configFile.description: JSON file, relative to the project, whose keys override these options (enabled, tokensFile, extensions, ignore, allow, allowSvgColors, blockBashWrites, watchBash, maxReported).

tokensFile.title: Tokens file
tokensFile.description: Where the allowed design tokens live, relative to the project: a JSON tokens file (nested, $value or value leaves) or a CSS/SCSS/Less file of variables.

ignore.title: Ignored paths
ignore.description: Comma-separated globs the guard skips, such as **/*.stories.tsx,legacy/**.

allow.title: Allowed values
allow.description: Comma-separated values never flagged, such as 0,1px.
